backward_compat_traps.rule: PROFINET addresses devices by NameOfStation (DCP), not by a fixed IP/bus address.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Treating a fixed IP as the device identity breaks name-based AR establishment and device replacement.

backward_compat_traps.rule: RT cyclic data rides Layer-2 on EtherType 0x8892, bypassing TCP/IP.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Routing RT cyclic data through the IP stack defeats real-time determinism.

backward_compat_traps.rule: IRT (CC-C) requires fixed, planned topology and offline scheduling plus PTCP sync hardware.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Assuming IRT works on an arbitrary/auto topology like RT fails the schedule.

backward_compat_traps.rule: PROFINET uses the XML GSDML, NOT the keyword-based PROFIBUS GSD text file.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Re-using a PROFIBUS GSD as a PROFINET device description is wrong.

backward_compat_traps.rule: CC-C implies IRT-capable hardware (PROFINET ASIC/FPGA with scheduler + PTCP); CC-A/CC-B may be software RT.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Claiming CC-C on a standard NIC without IRT hardware fails certification.

fields.spec_version: PROFINET IO — IEC 61158 (Type 10) and IEC 61784-2 (Communication Profile Family 3, CPF 3), maintained by PI (PROFIBUS & PROFINET International)
previous_versions: PROFINET CBA (Component Based Automation) — the older component-model variant; deprecated and superseded by PROFINET IO.

key_changes.summary: Defines the device roles (IO-Controller/IO-Device/IO-Supervisor), GSDML device description, DCP name-based addressing, the AR/CR connection model (IO-CR/Record-Data-CR/Alarm-CR), cyclic provider/consumer data with IOPS/IOCS and APDU Cycle Counter/Data Status, acyclic CL-RPC records, the performance classes NRT/RT/IRT, the conformance classes CC-A/CC-B/CC-C, PTCP time sync, and MRP media redundancy, all on standard switched IEEE 802.3 Ethernet.

future_versions_industry_outline.summary: Later PI work maps PROFINET onto IEEE 802.1 Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN) for standardized scheduling/redundancy at higher speeds, preserving the same device/AR/CR/GSDML model.

fields.version_naming_history_note: PROFINET is standardized in IEC 61158 (Type 10) and IEC 61784-2 (Communication Profile Family 3) and maintained by PI (PROFIBUS & PROFINET International), the same organization behind the serial PROFIBUS fieldbus. PROFINET is the Ethernet successor to PROFIBUS, replacing RS-485 token-passing / SD1-SD4 telegrams / GSD / DPV1 with switched Ethernet, GSDML, names, and a provider/consumer cyclic model. The communication profiles RT_CLASS_1 / RT_CLASS_2 / RT_CLASS_3(IRT) / RT_CLASS_UDP correspond to the NRT/RT/IRT performance classes.
